name: Infernal Blade
description: A landed attack brands the target, disarming it for %duration% turn. The countdown only advances on turns the branded unit ends away from this one, and repeat hits stack more time onto the brand.

upgrade.summary: Striking a branded unit deals %bonus_damage% extra damage and stuns it for %stun_duration% turn.
details: An attack that lands on an already-branded unit deals %bonus_damage% more damage and stuns it for %stun_duration% turn.
Unlike the brand, the stun does not stack - repeat hits refresh it rather than piling it up.
